answer.content: The research question must be derived directly from empirical data in Section 4.1 of Kumar et al., 2024, focusing on quantified retention rates across 50 update intervals with bounded token budgets. It must avoid theoretical assumptions and reference only metrics explicitly measured and reported in the paper's evaluation section. Acceptance criteria: the question must be answerable using only data from the specified section and must not introduce external or unverified metrics beyond those experimentally observed and reported in the study's results table or figures.
